## Testing

- [ ] `bun run lint`
- [ ] `bun run typecheck`
- [ ] `bun run test`
- [ ] Manual verification completed
- [ ] Screenshots attached for UI changes

For changes to key derivation, signing, secure storage, or the network switch,
a green build is not enough — link a testnet transaction, a deployed address,
or a recording of the flow.

## AI assistance

- [ ] This PR was written with AI assistance

A signal for reviewers, not a judgement — see CONTRIBUTING.md. You are the
author of every line either way, and should be able to explain any of it.

## Risk Check

- [ ] No secret, mnemonic, private key, or signing material appears in this PR,
      its fixtures, or its screenshots
- [ ] Nothing secret was given an `EXPO_PUBLIC_` prefix (those ship to users)
- [ ] Secure storage behavior was reviewed if auth, wallet, or session code changed
- [ ] Network/API changes were reviewed for breaking behavior
- [ ] This touches keys, auth, signing, or `ACTIVE_NETWORK` (expect closer review)
- [ ] This adds or updates a dependency
- [ ] This change is safe to roll back
